content.comment_body: Hello, I have a [product_name] [article_no]. After pressing something on the device screen by mistake, I am unable to operate it now. On startup, the screen displays options like Setup, Network, and Diagnostics. Selecting Setup displays further options: Msg Config, Start Screen, LCD, Menu Lang, Switch to ADMIN. When I choose ADMIN, it asks for a password. I entered 'LOGO' but nothing happens. Any advice?

Welcome to the forum. The default password to switch to ADMIN mode is usually 'LOGO'. If this password does not work on your [product_name], it may have been changed. Open [product_name] Soft Comfort. Go to Tools > Transfer > Access Control. The Transfer window will open; select the correct IP address and click OK. When prompted, set your [product_name] to stop. Scroll to 'Control Operation from the [product_name] TD' and check 'Allow operation from the [product_name] TD' and 'Enable password protection for operation control.' Fill in both fields with your new password, and click Apply. Finally, switch your [product_name] to run mode.
Thank you for your response. I forgot to mention that I have the demo version. Do I need the full version to complete these steps?
With the demo version of [product_name] Soft Comfort, you cannot perform any functions that require connecting to the base module.
Yes, I have realized I can't do anything with the demo version. Thanks for your help.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is locked out of their [product_name] device after inadvertently interacting with the screen, leading to password issues. The demo version of [product_name] Soft Comfort software lacks the necessary functionality for password reset or device connection, making resolution difficult without the full version. The guidance points to software limitations rather than device-based solutions, and users are uncertain about alternative recovery options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to restore access to their [product_name] device and reset or override the admin password without purchasing the full software. They hope for step-by-step instructions using available resources and seek straightforward solutions to regain control of the device.
